add.k: A Worthington Labs scientist working on the mutant cure
st: Dr. Rao shows Hank McCoy the boy Jimmy and readies the cure for Warren, then dies when Magneto's mutants storm Alcatraz.

files.notes: Named on screen: Hank says 'Thank you, Dr. Rao' at Worthington Labs (springfieldspringfield x-men-the-last-stand). 'Kavita' is not in the dialogue, so n is 'Dr. Rao'. Group 'Worthington Labs' is said on screen ('Secretary McCoy, welcome to Worthington Labs'). Her killer (Quill) is never named in the dialogue, so the step says only Magneto's mutants. Her page_file was empty; facts from the cached Marvel Movies wiki plot and the transcript.

add.k: Secretary Trask, the U.S. official hunting Magneto
st: Secretary Trask briefs the President on Mystique's capture, then sends troops to raid Magneto's camp, only to find a decoy.

files.notes: Named on screen: 'Secretary Trask here' and the President's 'And Trask, you have to find Magneto' (transcript). A different man from the app's Bolivar Trask; never given a first name. Group: the President says 'Homeland Security was tracking Magneto' and Trask goes on 'We got hits in Lisbon, Geneva, Montreal', so Homeland Security; not in groups_in_app, so check if the app prefers another label. Filed as A: he serves the government against Magneto, not against the X-Men.

add.k: The sergeant who leads Stryker's soldiers
st: Sergeant Lyman reports Stryker's Cerebro finished, then dies guarding its door when Magneto sets off his men's grenades.

files.notes: Named on screen: Stryker says 'I'm a scientist, Sergeant Lyman' and 'Sergeant Lyman, gather your men and meet me outside Cerebro' (transcript x2). Group: X2 never names Stryker's force; 'U.S. Army' follows the app's own Stryker file for X2 (Stryker is called Colonel). Use 'Independent' if the build wants a group said on screen. The grenade death is from his wiki page. The 'Sergeant?' line at the mansion raid may be him but is not certain, so it is left out.

add.k: A guard at Magneto's plastic prison
st: Laurio taunts Magneto in his plastic prison, until Mystique fills his blood with iron and Magneto tears it out of him to escape.

files.notes: Named on screen: Magneto calls him 'Mr Laurio' twice and Mystique says 'Mr Laurio?' at the bar (transcript x2); his full name is shown on his profile in Stryker's files (the wiki gallery's 'Laurio Profile' screenshot). The prison's employer is never named, so tm is Independent. He collapses when Magneto pulls the iron out of him; the wiki lists him as deceased.

st: Ronny resents his brother Bobby's powers and calls the police, saying mutants are holding his family in their house.

files.notes: Named on screen: Bobby says 'Ronny? Is anybody home?' and 'Ronny, next time you...', and Bobby says 'Ronny.' at the standoff; Jean says 'Boston, with Bobby Drake's family' (transcript x2). No group. Filed on the Raft because his one act is turning the police on Bobby and the X-Men; he could equally be a hero file as family.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Dr. Rao welcomes Secretary McCoy to Worthington Labs on Alcatraz and introduces him to Jimmy, the boy behind the cure. Later she warns that Hank's politics sit at odds with his own nature.
stages.whoA: The Secretary of Mutant Affairs who tours her lab
stages.whoB: The scientist who shows him the cure's source

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Dr. Rao keeps Jimmy at Worthington Labs on Alcatraz until his DNA is mapped, since his genes are the source of the cure. She brings Hank McCoy in to meet him.
stages.whoA: The boy whose genes make the cure
stages.whoB: The scientist who keeps him at the lab

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Trask and Hank sit with the President as Trask reports Mystique's capture at the FDA. Hank later resigns over the cure weapons while Trask leads the hunt for Magneto.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Mystique is caught breaking into the FDA while posing as Secretary Trask. After Magneto abandons her, she tells the government where his camp is, and Trask sends troops in.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who posed as him

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Lyman leads Stryker's soldiers at Alkali Lake and reports that the Cerebro machine is finished. When he asks why the children are being held, Stryker brushes him off, then posts him and his men at the Cerebro door.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Lyman and Yuriko both serve Stryker at Alkali Lake. They stand at his side as his operation runs.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Lyman and his men guard the door to Cerebro with orders to shoot anyone who comes near. Magneto pulls the pins from their grenades and kills them all.
stages.whoA: The mutant who kills him at Cerebro's door

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Laurio guards Magneto in his plastic prison and taunts him. After Mystique fills Laurio's blood with iron, Magneto pulls it out of his body to break free.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he guards and taunts

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Mystique, calling herself Grace, picks Laurio up at a bar and drugs him. She injects him with iron so Magneto can use it to escape.
stages.whoA: The woman who drugs him at a bar
stages.whoB: The guard she drugs to free Magneto

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Bobby brings Logan, Rogue and John home and tells his family he is a mutant. Jealous and upset, Ronny calls the police, and Bobby realizes it was him before he leaves with the others.
stages.whoB: His younger brother, who calls the police

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Ronny comes home to find Logan in the house, introduced as Professor Logan. His call brings the police, and an officer shoots Logan during the standoff.
stages.whoA: The stranger his call brings the police on
stages.whoB: Bobby's brother, who calls the police

dropped.why: Never named on screen: in X-Men: The Last Stand he is only 'Mr. President' and 'the President' (transcript x-men-the-last-stand checked); no name is said or shown, as with Dimitri Olshenko's 'Prime Minister'.
Never named on screen: X2's dialogue calls him only 'Mr President' (transcript x2 checked, no 'McKenna'), and no source shows the name on screen. Credits-only name.

His own name is never said in X-Men: The Last Stand: he is only 'Dad', 'sir' and 'the guy that invented the cure'; 'Worthington' is said only as the company name 'Worthington Labs' (transcript checked). No source shows a caption naming him. Restore if a news caption at the press conference names him.

changes.where: ties: Trask / Hank McCoy, X-Men: The Last Stand, text
changes.was: Trask and Hank sit with the President as Trask reports Mystique's capture and the cure she stole from the FDA. Hank later resigns over the cure weapons while Trask leads the hunt for Magneto.
changes.now: Trask and Hank sit with the President as Trask reports Mystique's capture at the FDA. Hank later resigns over the cure weapons while Trask leads the hunt for Magneto.
changes.why: Trask reports only Mystique's capture at the FDA; it is the President, not Trask, who hands Hank the Worthington Labs file on what she stole.
